goal: Prevent nodes using private broadcast from leaking transaction ownership over clearnet
Stop the wallet from automatically resubmitting dropped unconfirmed transactions to the local mempool
agreement: Unaddressed objection: coupling wallet rebroadcast to -privatebroadcast contradicts docs (vasild)
Support for protecting transactions originating outside normal wallet sends from rebroadcast (andrewtoth)
Support after removing mempool resubmission completely under private broadcast (davidgumberg)
Concept approval without stated reasons (darosior, w0xlt)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes an origin privacy leak where nodes serve dropped transactions to peers
Prevents passive or active peers from identifying the node as the sender or receiver

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it prevents wallet rebroadcast behavior from undermining user privacy settings
Eliminates unexpected clearnet rebroadcasts of dropped incoming or watch-only payments
